iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

CACHE_REQUEST
       Triggered when the system receives a request for a cached object.

DESCRIPTION
       Triggered when the system receives a request for an object eligible to be cached. Used to override default behavior.

Examples
	when CACHE_REQUEST {
	  if { [CACHE::age] > 60 } {
	    CACHE::expire
	    log local0. "Expiring content: Age > 60 seconds"
	   }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.3 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
